title: Book Cocoon Flat | Rosemary Beach Condo for Vacationers | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
h1: The Cocoon Flat at Rosemary Beach
meta_description: One of our fantastic Rosemary Beach condo rentals, Cocoon Flat is the perfect property for your getaway. Click here to see inside this lovely condo!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Lots of people love to come to the Rosemary Beach® community for its laid-back lifestyle. The town is everything you need for relaxation and making memories, and Cocoon Flat is the perfect vacation home for large families or small groups of friends who are doing just that.

This friendly, welcoming beach home is full of warmth and style. As soon as you walk in, you’re greeted with natural colors with accents of happy blues and golden teak. The house has lots of windows for day lighting and lots of lights to brighten up your evenings.

Relax in the comfy living room, which has enough seating for everyone. Watch the flat screen TV or just talk about all the fun you’re having in the Rosemary Beach community. If you’re hungry, there’s no need to decide where to eat every night—you can simply cook at home on the stainless steel appliances. Serve your delicious creations at the dining table and breakfast bar or head out to the patio and enjoy the tropical air while you dine.

One of the favorite things about the décor in this house is all the texturing. Layers of wood, metal, marble, and modern art are both interesting and uplifting. The lighting is also well-layered, with pendant, table, and fan lights highlighting the canister lights in the ceiling. This is part of what makes this home pop with light any time of the day.

The master bedroom has a rustic look, and the layered lighting here helps make it bright and welcoming at all hours. The master suite has an en suite bath with gorgeous modern glass walk in shower with double shower heads and his-and-hers sinks. Another bedroom with a queen-sized bed also has two built-in bunk beds, each with its own reading light—perfect for the kids!

If you want to take a tour around the area, take the two complimentary adult bikes and hit the road! Have lunch or dinner at one of the fine restaurants or cafes, then go shopping at the boutiques or head down to the beach to check out the warm sand, bright sun, and beautiful waters of the Gulf of Mexico. If you want to play golf, there are several championship courses nearby.

When you rent one of our fantastic rentals, you will see the difference the little details make in a vacation home. Contact us today to book the Cocoon Flat and make your vacation the best it can be.

This property requires a 4 night minimum stay during spring break and summer and a 3 night minimum stay during shoulder season. Interested in a longer stay with special pricing? Call 866-348-8952 to speak with a Vacation Planner!
